notes: InstallMethod::SkillsSh, project scope. academy-guide is installed, then its SKILL.md is corrupted by this script (not the CLI) so update has a real, deterministic content change to refetch and restore - verified by before/after sha256, not stdout wording (skills update always prints Updated regardless of whether content changed). Surprising real-CLI behavior found while recording: even though neither the initial add nor this update ever passed --agent claude-code, update on its own initiative added a .claude/skills/academy-guide symlink not present in before/ - recorded as-is, since UpdateRequest carries no harness selector for ops to claim anything about either. Every file body under a skills/<name>/ folder fetched from a remote source (including LICENSE.txt, when present) is stored on disk as a one-line stub (`stub sha256=<original hash> bytes=<n>`), never the real third-party content; tree.json still records the ORIGINAL sha256/length, and cli_parity.rs compares against that original hash, not the stub's own bytes.
